structured_output.strongest_bear_case: TRUMPTV is one of 11+ same-name tokens launched within ~4 hours after the White House started the "TRUMP TV: The Essentials Station" stream (2026-09-21, 7pm ET). This token has no provable official link, no website and no DexScreener profile. The trading looks manufactured. In the last hour 1,228 unique wallets bought but only 37 sold, and those 37 made 4,218 sell trades (about 114 each). That points to a small group of wallets selling into retail buyers. About $8.6M traded on a ~$105k market cap, roughly 82x turnover, which suggests bot or wash volume. The top 10 holders own 97.3%. The creator's raw balance of ~8.84e14 is roughly 88% of supply if the token has 6 decimals and a 1B supply (fits price and mcap; decimals not verified). The pool also looks empty. RugCheck puts total market liquidity at ~$0.0000009, and DexScreener's live pair data shows $0 liquidity (0.0038 base tokens, 4e-9 SOL), yet it still records ~$338k of trades in the last 5 minutes. So the $186k liquidity figure in the packet is unreliable, and the token may be untradeable or already drained. The news catalyst is real but is a single event the token borrowed, not a durable story of its own.
